name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says you must have flipped the switch before reaching the exit, but the only clause is Existence(at_exit). An episode that reaches the exit with the switch never toggled satisfies it. Add hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit); with Existence(at_exit) it also forces the switch to be toggled, so no extra Existence is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) enforces that the switch flip must happen first, matching 'reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first'.

texts: The switch must be toggled before reaching the exit.
